title: God’s Eyes Look Everywhere
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
King Asa trusted God for years,
But one day he forgot
To ask the Lord to help him first,
He fixed it, so he thought.

[Chorus]
I’ll trust the Lord in everything,
The big things and the small,
His eyes look all around the earth
To help me when I call.

[Verse 2]
Hanani came and gently said,
“Why didn’t you first pray?
His eyes look all around the earth
For those who trust His way.”

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
If you forget, like Asa did,
Just turn to God, He’s there,
Now close your eyes; His eyes still watch
With love and gentle care.

[Chorus]
mood: Forgiving music. A gentle, slow rocking sway moves under the voice, soft and understanding, like someone who has seen many mistakes and loves anyway, matching a good king who simply forgot to ask God first. The chorus is calm and reassuring, never scolding, with a quiet lift on the picture of God's eyes looking everywhere. By the last verse the rocking slows and sinks lower, settling into a warm, watchful hush.
